items.title: New Zealand rearguard holds India to draw first Test
items.summary: New Zealand have batted strongly on the final day to secure a draw with India, which boosted Australia's standing in the World Test Championship.

items.title: Jobs cuts will diminish Tasmanian museum, historian says
items.summary: A sole archivist will be the last-remaining staff member of a Tasmanian museum's history department after job cuts at Launceston's Queen Victoria Museum and Art Gallery.

items.title: Woolworths reveals $100k in payments after discovering supply chain underpayments
items.summary: The NSW government announces plans for a modern slavery taskforce as one of the nation's retail giants reveals its own scrutiny led to $100,000 in payments to workers in its fruit and vegetable supply chains.

items.title: Woman allegedly unbuckled 7yo boy's seatbelt before crashing into pole
items.summary: Following an investigation police charged a 38-year-old woman with attempted murder after she allegedly unbuckled the seatbelt of her 7-year-old passenger before car crash.

items.title: Devastating injury blow for Adams days after making Socceroos debut
items.summary: Talented attacker Eli Adams could be sidelined for up to a year after receiving some nasty injury news right after making his international bow.

items.title: Woman on trial for murder after failing to protect baby from abusive father
items.summary: During the prosecution's opening address, the jury heard they would hear medical evidence that Rhuan allegedly suffered significant injuries including a fractured skull at his Yugar home.

items.title: Prisoner death inquest told interviewing officer inexperienced, unprepared
items.summary: A WA Police officer says she was mocked by her colleagues after a detainee she interviewed carried out his threat to kill himself days later, a coronial inquest has heard.

items.title: Jim Chalmers says he doesn't expect a recession, but 'things might get a bit harder'
items.summary: The Treasurer said the government was on track for cuts to more than cover any new spending in next month's mid-year budget update and that forecasts would project higher unemployment and lower growth.

items.title: Our favourite sweet treats and savoury dishes from Recipe of the Year
items.summary: Feeling inspired to get cooking after watching Recipe of the Year? We've collated some of the show's favourite recipes for you to enjoy at home.

items.title: Sneaky sales trick lures rats into traps, study finds
items.summary: Black rats can be difficult to trap, but a common marketing tactic in shops and restaurants increases capture rates, a new study shows.

items.title: Pop stars and politicians pay tribute to music guru Molly Meldrum
items.summary: Kylie Minogue, Jimmy Barnes and Anthony Albanese have joined tributes to the former Countdown legend, who has died at the age of 83.

items.title: ‘Love makes fools of us all’: Defence closing address in Lamarre-Condon trial
items.summary: Defence barrister John Stratton, SC, told the NSW Supreme Court jury that “the fate of the accused is in your hands”.

items.title: Inside the Coalition’s plans for a youth offender ‘prison bootcamp’
items.summary: Voters in Shepparton are unhappy with the proposal to reopen Dhurringile Prison as a ‘bootcamp’ for young people.

items.title: Wife ‘submitted’ to fatal attacks on baby, jury told
items.summary: A self-described “submissive wife” has been accused of indirectly killing her baby son by failing to stop her husband’s alleged violent abuse.

items.title: ‘No use pretending otherwise’: Chalmers warns of tough year ahead as jobless and inflation forecasts worsen
items.summary: Jim Chalmers is warning of a year “full of risks”, saying unemployment and inflation will be higher and economic growth slower.

items.title: Teen e-motorbike rider allegedly carrying ounces of cannabis at time of fatal Edgewater crash
items.summary: Prosecutors alleged the 17-year-old also had cannabis in his system at the time of the crash that claimed the life of a nurse in 2025.

items.title: Smith stunned after lbw decision

items.title: Footage of Ryan Cho at the Austin Hospital.
items.summary: Cho had pleaded guilty to filming more than 800 hospital staff using toilets.

items.title: No one threw a party like Molly Meldrum. I know because I nearly died at one
items.summary: Molly opened up Countdown to bands that didn’t fit the norm, including my own, the Painters & Dockers. And by hell we partied together.

items.title: Mother in murder trial after death of six month old son
items.summary: The trial of a Sunshine Coast mother accused of murdering her six-month-old son has begun.
